briefings.title: How She Got Peter Thiel to Anchor Her First Fund (Without Pitching Him)
briefings.tldr: Keri Findley, founder of Tacora Capital, leverages a "ratings arbitrage" strategy to invest in highly illiquid credit assets that traditional institutions cannot hold, generating alpha by solving complex financing problems for venture-backed startups.

briefings.title: Why Most VCs Misunderstand Peter Thiel’s Power Law
briefings.tldr: High-performance venture capital is less about chasing "magical" unicorn frameworks and more about returning to the fundamentals of value investing: selecting singular, non-conforming founders, protecting their leadership at all costs, and focusing on the next 3-5x growth cycle rather than hindsight-driven power laws.

briefings.title: JD Vance’s Co-Founder on Space Defense, Hard Tech, and Solving Hard Problems
briefings.tldr: Narya co-founder Colin advocates for a "regressive" venture capital strategy that returns to the industry’s roots of solving critical national problems in defense, space, and manufacturing through concentrated, first-principles investing rather than chasing speculative market trends.
